climate.description: A March race from coastal Castellón into Sierra de Espadán; the organizer has not published a 2027 weather protocol.
challenges: Temperature and wind can change between the coast and the natural-park summits

terrain.surface: The provisional 2027 course is 156.6 km with approximately 2,211 m of climbing through Sierra de Espadán Natural Park, featuring the summits of Aín and Salto del Caballo. The organizer says the route may change because of roadworks or other unforeseen events.
features: Provisional 156.6 km course with approximately 2,211 m of climbing
Major summits at Aín and Salto del Caballo

fondo_rating.scoring_notes: Refreshed for the organizer-confirmed 2027 edition. The provisional route supports a high climbing score, but a March Mediterranean start and no published high-altitude exposure do not support the previous maximum climate-risk or altitude ratings. Score recalculated: 73.

course_description.character: The provisional 2027 course is a single 156.6 km route with approximately 2,211 m of climbing through Sierra de Espadán Natural Park. The organizer currently highlights the summits of Aín and Salto del Caballo and warns that roadworks or other contingencies may change the final route.
course_description.signature_challenge: Linking the Aín and Salto del Caballo summits inside a 156.6 km race with more than 2,200 m of total climbing.
suffering_zones: Aín — one of the two major summits named on the provisional 2027 course
Salto del Caballo — the second major summit named by the organizer
Sierra de Espadán — sustained climbing inside the natural park before the return to Castellón

logistics.transport: Nearest airports: Valencia (VLC) and Castellón-Costa Azahar (CDT). The organizer says the final 2027 timetable is coming soon; its current provisional locations place the village at the Fair and Markets Complex and start/finish on Avenida Chatellerault.

history.origin_story: Founded 2024 (inaugural March 10, Vila-Real); 1,400+ cyclists from 27 nations. 2024 winners: Lepoutre, de Vries; ambassadors Ivan Basso, Purito Rodriguez, Ibon Zugasti (category winner). Qualifiers advanced to Aalborg Worlds. 2025/2026 in Castellón de la Plana[1][2][4][5]

biased_opinion.summary: The Millars reaches its fourth edition in 2027 with real momentum: it is a UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier, and its 2026 edition sold out at 2,000 riders from 36 nationalities. The provisional 2027 route is 156.6 km with approximately 2,211 m of climbing through Sierra de Espadán Natural Park, including the Aín and Salto del Caballo summits. This is a timed qualifier, not a casual cyclotourist ride, and the organization is building an international field quickly. What it still lacks is longevity, and the organizer explicitly warns that the provisional route can change because of roadworks or other contingencies.
strengths: Genuine UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier — a fast top-25% in your age group sends you to Worlds
One provisional 156.6 km route with more than 2,200 m of climbing, so there is no soft option diluting the field
International draw from 27 countries in its 2024 debut, sold out at 2,000 riders from 36 nationalities by year three
Ambassador roster (Ivan Basso, Purito Rodríguez, Fabio Aru) signals real investment from the organizer
weaknesses: Young event — the 2027 race is only its fourth edition, so there is limited track record on consistency year to year
No shorter medio fondo option is currently published for 2027
Non-federation-licensed riders pay a €12 surcharge on top of registration, plus optional €20 cancellation insurance
The official route is explicitly described as provisional and can change for roadworks or other contingencies
biased_opinion.bottom_line: If you want a serious, timed UCI qualifier on a genuinely hard Spanish coastal-mountain course and don't mind a young organizer still building its reputation, The Millars delivers. It is not a beginner's gran fondo — there's no shorter route to fall back on.

final_verdict.one_liner: A UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier through Sierra de Espadán Natural Park
final_verdict.should_you_race: Yes if you want a UCI-qualifying result and can handle a provisional 156.6 km course with more than 2,200 m of climbing and no published bailout distance. Skip if you're newer to gran fondos and want a shorter option, or if you want a race with decades of established reputation behind it.
final_verdict.alternatives: If you want a longer-established Spanish UCI qualifier with a shorter distance option: Aitana Tour (Alicante). If you want the Mediterranean-coast climbing test without the UCI qualifier pressure: look at regional Comunitat Valenciana cyclotourist rides.

videos.title: 🔥 Millars UCI Gran Fondo de Castellón  con IBON ZUGASTI🚴💨
videos.description:
🚲 ¡Bienvenidos, DISFRUTONES DEL CICLISMO!

En este video os traigo una experiencia brutal en la Millars Gran Fondo de Castellón, una marcha cicloturista UCI con 158 km y 2.200 metros de desnivel. Pero lo mejor de todo… ¡compartiendo kilómetros con el bicharraco Ibon Zugasti! 🔥

Nos enfrentamos a los puertos de Aín y el Salto del Caballo, con rampas durísimas, paisajes espectaculares y un ritmo muy exigente ¿Cómo fue rodar junto a una leyenda del ciclismo? ¡Os lo cuento todo en el video!

⚠️ Bajadas con máxima precaución para disfrutar de la jornada con seguridad.

👦 Sobre mí: soy padre de tres hijas y ciclista desde hace 7 años. Me apasiona este deporte y trato de ayudar a quienes empiezan, porque sé lo duro que pueden ser los comienzos.

📸 Instagram: @fnz1986
🐦 Twitter: @FranMorcillo
🎵 TikTok: @fran.morcillo
🚴 Strava: Fran Morcillo

Si te gusta el contenido, ¡suscríbete y dale a like! 🚴‍♂️💨
